title: limonium pectinatum
intro: Limonium pectinatum, commonly known as Sea Lavender, is a flowering plant species native to the coastal regions of the Mediterranean. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, which may help to soothe skin irritations and protect against cell damage. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its calming and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential treatment for anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Limonium pectinatum include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
